_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang unchanged at 0.40.0's merge commit (still a SHA, not a tag -- pine-lang doesn't tag releases). beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.53.0, which adds Zen mode, a docked Settings panel, canvas text that scales with Text Size, and a Reconnect action for a dead database connection.
